shop.introDefault: Every Gandhi Brothers product is made with care in Junagadh and shipped across India.
shop.introChurna: Churnas are fine herbal powders — one of the oldest and most useful forms in Ayurveda. We prepare each one in small batches from carefully chosen herbs, sieve it to a consistent texture, and pack it under our FDCA licence in Junagadh. Pick your pack size on any product below.
shop.introTaila: Tailas are medicated oils. We slow-cook herbs into a base oil so their goodness passes into it. We follow traditional methods under our FDCA licence in Junagadh. Browse the range below and pick the size that suits you.

footer.tagline: We bring the healing wisdom of real Ayurveda from Junagadh straight to your home — pure, trusted, and properly certified.
footer.disclaimer: Ayurvedic medicine. For best results, use only under a qualified doctor's guidance. Not meant to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

home.heroSubtitle: For three generations, our family has stood behind the counter in Junagadh, sharing the healing wisdom of Ayurveda. Today, we bring those same trusted, time-tested products directly to you — made with care and FDCA-certified.
home.staplesSubtitle: These are the products our community has trusted for decades. We make them in small, careful batches so every pouch and bottle meets the standard our grandfather set.
home.catalogueLoading: Catalogue loading — please check back shortly.
home.offerBody: We believe real wellness comes from pure ingredients and centuries of knowledge. Explore our full range of traditional products, properly made and delivered straight to your home anywhere in India.
home.t1Quote: I have recommended Gandhi Brothers Triphala for two years. The texture, taste, and quality are exactly right for a classical preparation.
home.t2Quote: Three generations of my family have bought medicines from JGV in Junagadh. This new brand keeps up that same standard.
home.t3Quote: They follow the rules carefully, which is rare in this industry — correct batch numbers, traceable ingredients, and proper FDCA paperwork.
